notes.title: v1.TOO_SWEET Update
notes.content:
[b]New v1.TOO_SWEET features: [/b]

Five new unlockable ships.
Ship rotates in the direction you move. 
Show count of ships unlocked and total on Join screen.
Mouse controls work on Quit/Exit menus.
Add support for Steam Stats. 

Available now!!!

notes.title: Release Notes v1.1
notes.content:
Release Notes v1.1

[b]NEW FEATURES:[/b]
New artwork for most waves.
Add blocks that shrink when hit.
New level to showcase shrinking blocks.
Add three new perks.
Add 8-bit voices for start game, new wave, and game over.
First two bonus levels are now accessed by destroying special blocks hidden within levels.

[b]UPDATES / FIXES:[/b]
St Patrick's Day level now part of level rotation.
Update Join screen UI to include ship names. 
Ghost Ship names changed.
Updates to Pyramid Scheme wave to reduce difficulty.
If a sound is already playing, restart it rather than starting a second instance.
Level 1 lasers now alternate offset right and left.
Center shot on level 3 and 4 lasers is forward from the side lasers.
Reduce slow motion time. 
Performance improvements.
Coin collision rectangles slightly bigger.

notes.title: Release Notes v1.02
notes.content:
Hypership Out of Control 2 v1.02 released 4/6/2019

Updated Pyramid Scheme level to be easier. 
Updated Game Over screen to show comparison between your score and the top score. 
Update Game Over screen to display coins collected during run that just completed.
